name: screen
description: GNU Screen, a full-screen terminal multiplexer that lets several processes (typically shells) run in one physical terminal, with session detach/reattach support.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
